records.name: V4 tokenizer
records.purpose: The only tokenizer accepted by new training and inference lineages.
records.runtime_cost: 32,768-token vocabulary
records.evidence: Pinned artifact, metadata hash, fertility and round-trip gates.
records.evidence_required: Artifact hash and round-trip contract remain valid.
records.rollback: Restore the same signed V4 artifact; never fall back to V3.
promotion_history: Promoted as the sole canonical tokenizer.

records.name: Licensed corpus pipeline
records.purpose: Builds immutable licensed, deduplicated and split training data.
records.runtime_cost: Offline acquisition and token packing.
records.evidence: Signed manifests exist for train, validation and test shards.
records.evidence_required: Every consumed shard must match its signed hash and license record.
records.rollback: Reject the changed manifest and reuse the prior immutable corpus release.

records.name: Dense V4 transformer
records.purpose: The canonical 181,132,071-parameter language-model foundation.
records.runtime_cost: One dense 181M forward/backward path.
records.evidence: Architecture and bounded optimizer/resume paths passed; no useful trained V4 checkpoint exists yet.
records.evidence_required: Coherent milestone checkpoint plus held-out behavioral evaluation.
records.rollback: Restore the last protected dense checkpoint and its exact architecture contract.

records.name: Schema-9 exact resume
records.purpose: Restores model, optimizer, scheduler, scaler, RNG and sampler cursor.
records.runtime_cost: Checkpoint serialization and restore validation.
records.claimed_benefit: Continuation without replaying or skipping accepted token windows.
records.evidence: Local optimizer-boundary termination and resume drill passed.
records.evidence_required: Cross-worker remote handoff must also pass before a cloud campaign.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Multi-token prediction
records.purpose: Adds +2/+3 future-token objectives without changing the tokenizer.
records.runtime_cost: Two additional tied future-token projections and losses.
records.claimed_benefit: Richer predictive representations and data efficiency.
records.evidence: One bounded full-model GPU step succeeded; no matched capability win exists.
records.evidence_required: Paired dense-versus-MTP continuation from the same checkpoint and windows.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Sparse upcycled MoE
records.purpose: Routes tokens through replicated feed-forward experts.
records.runtime_cost: Current eight-expert form raises the 181M system to 1,122,620,199 parameters.
records.claimed_benefit: Higher parameter capacity at sparse token compute.
records.evidence: Routing code executes, but the current geometry is unsuitable for the T4 baseline.
records.evidence_required: A redesigned sparse-upcycling pilot with stable load balance and useful-compute gain.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Mixture of Depths routing
records.purpose: Selects bounded token computation across transformer layers.
records.runtime_cost: Routing overhead with potential skipped token-layer work.
records.evidence: Gradient and routing unit paths execute; no trained capability gain is established.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: RIM and ESV identity modulation
records.purpose: Provides neutral-initialized residual identity modulation and state estimates.
records.runtime_cost: Small per-layer projections and state prediction.
records.evidence: Neutral initialization and execution are covered; intelligence value is unproven.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Dynamic temperature path
records.purpose: Applies bounded learned attention-temperature controls.
records.runtime_cost: Scalar controls per transformer layer.
records.evidence: The mechanism is wired and neutralized; no matched capability evidence exists.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: External HAL policy
records.purpose: Applies bounded external state and reasoning-budget policy.
records.runtime_cost: Small policy and telemetry overhead outside the transformer.
records.claimed_benefit: Inspectable control without entangling base weights.
records.evidence: External bounded policy executes; task-level benefit is not established.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Transformer-integrated HAL
records.purpose: Modulates transformer attention from HAL state.
records.runtime_cost: Per-layer attention modulation.
records.evidence: Forced off in the canonical dense profile.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Cross-scale identity inheritance
records.purpose: Transfers a trained smaller model into a larger compatible child.
records.runtime_cost: One-time tensor migration followed by alignment training.
records.claimed_benefit: Reuse learned behavior when growing 181M to 500M.
records.evidence: Tiny-model cosine parity exists; full hybrid-attention parity remains required.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: TurboQuant KV-cache pilot
records.purpose: Compresses persistent inference keys and values with a device-resident randomized rotation and bit-packed scalar quantizer.
records.runtime_cost: Dequantizes the retained history before SDPA; no fused QJL attention kernel exists yet, so latency may regress.
records.claimed_benefit: Approximately 3.76x persistent KV storage reduction versus BF16 at 4 bits for 64-dimensional heads.
records.evidence: Real nibble packing, physical-byte accounting, distortion telemetry, and a fail-closed generation gate are implemented.
records.evidence_required: A trained V4 checkpoint must pass long-context capability, distribution-drift, peak-VRAM, and tokens/second gates.
records.rollback: Select the exact float KV backend; model weights are unchanged.

records.name: Retrieval and long-term memory
records.purpose: Adds provenance-grounded knowledge without modifying base weights.
records.runtime_cost: Index lookup, reranking and context tokens.
records.claimed_benefit: Current, attributable and persistent external knowledge.
records.evidence: Retrieval and isolation tests exist; trained-model end-to-end quality remains blocked.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Verifier-guided self-correction
records.purpose: Generates, verifies, revises or abstains under an explicit budget.
records.runtime_cost: Additional candidates, verifier calls and trace storage.
records.evidence: Contracts and local verifier paths exist; a trained model has not passed the loop gate.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Reversible LoRA/DoRA capabilities
records.purpose: Adds hash-bound domain capabilities without overwriting base weights.
records.runtime_cost: Adapter parameters and optional routing overhead.
records.evidence: Binding and reversal paths exist; useful trained adapters remain to be produced.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: SFT, STaR, RLVR and DPO
records.purpose: Turns a pretrained language model into a useful instruction and reasoning model.
records.runtime_cost: Separate signed fine-tuning stages.
records.claimed_benefit: Instruction following and verifiable reasoning behavior.
records.evidence: Algorithms and ablation gates exist; no accepted V4 post-trained checkpoint exists.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Agents and tools
records.purpose: Plans and executes typed actions through bounded tools.
records.runtime_cost: Planning, tool execution and verification latency.
records.evidence: Local orchestration exists but canonical activation is operator-gated.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Moonshot architecture laboratory
records.purpose: Runs isolated SSM, latent reasoning, world-model and formal-system pilots.
records.runtime_cost: Pilot-specific; never charged to canonical training by default.
records.claimed_benefit: Discover architectures that outperform current subsystems.
records.evidence: Smoke paths exist; only bounded pilot evidence may promote an individual moonshot.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: Multimodal, robotics and world models
records.purpose: Extends the language foundation to perception and environment interaction.
records.runtime_cost: New encoders, data and environment interaction.
records.evidence: Research modules execute locally; no trained multimodal lineage is accepted.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.name: ThirdEye and Matrix evidence stream
records.purpose: Feeds run-level explanations and aggregate operational status from one evidence lineage.
records.runtime_cost: Structured event and summary storage.
records.claimed_benefit: One auditable truth surface rather than competing monitoring systems.
records.evidence: ThirdEye, Matrix, and the cluster export consume the same hash-chained anra-evidence-event/v1 contract.
records.rollback: disable the subsystem and restore the signed parent checkpoint

records.runtime_cost: None.
